counties.notes: Ramsey County (St. Paul metro, county seat St. Paul) hosts one of the richest public parcel REST layers in Minnesota. ParcelData/AttributedData/MapServer/0 (Parcels MultiUse) exposes 90+ fields including OwnerName/OwnerName1/OwnerName2/OwnerLastName, OwnerAddress1/2, OwnerCityStateZIP, TaxName1/2, TaxAddress1/2, TaxCityStateZIP, HomesteadName1/2, SiteAddress, SiteCityName, SiteZIP, EMV Land/Building/Total, TotalTax, LandUseCodeDescription, DwellingType, LivingAreaSquareFeet, YearBuilt, GarageYN, LastSaleDate, SalePrice, ParcelAcresDeed, SchoolDistrictName, WatershedDistrictNameTax. maxRecordCount is 1000. Query confirmed live: UPPER(OwnerName) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns real results (e.g., 'KING SMITH LLC' at '598 SMITH AVE S' in Saint Paul). Ramsey County is adjacent to Hennepin to the west and contains the state capital.

448,036 polygon parcels covering Minneapolis and the rest of Hennepin County. Verified 2026-05-11: UPPER(OWNER_NM) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns real owners (e.g., 'ALEX D SMITH', 'PAUL LOUIS SMITH'). Owner names are space-padded fixed-width, wrap searches in UPPER() and trim whitespace client-side. Full residential address columns present (HOUSE_NO, FRAC_HOUSE_NO, STREET_NM, MAILING_MUNIC_NM, ZIP_CD). PID is 13-digit composite (parcel-fragment-municipality-section). TORRENS_TYP flag distinguishes Torrens vs. Abstract land per Minnesota's dual-title system. OUTAGE RESOLVED 2026-06-06: the 2026-05 county-side outage cleared -- service re-verified live (448,083 parcels; OWNER_NM queries return real owners).

counties.notes: Mille Lacs County, Minnesota (county seat Milaca) publishes its parcels on its own ArcGIS Server 11.3 as MilleLacs_Public_101/MapServer layer 35 (Parcels), 20,083 rows with a taxpayer name on 2026-10-03. THE OWNER IS IN TAXPAYER_NAME, stored LAST/FIRST with a slash (SMITH/BRIAN & ASHLEY). A column called OWNER_NAME exists but is an empty string on about 97 percent of rows (544 of 20,083 populated on 2026-10-03; not NULL, so IS NOT NULL passes while the value is blank), and where it is populated it names a different party from TAXPAYER_NAME (a contract-for-deed holder or an LLC, for example), so the taxpayer is not always the owner of record. UPPER(OWNER_NAME) LIKE 'SMITH%' returns 0 features. OWNER_NAME is deliberately NOT listed as a search field here: the enrichment classifier takes the first owner-looking field, so listing it would route owner lookups to a mostly blank column. The mailing address is TAXPAYER_ADDRESS_1 to _4 (use _1 for the street); the matching OWNER_ADDRESS_1 to _4 columns were not checked. The site address is PROPERTY_ADDRESS with PROPERTY_ZIP and CITY_TWP_NAME. Search with UPPER(TAXPAYER_NAME) LIKE '%SMITH%'. maxRecordCount is 2000. CORS reflects the request Origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin echoed back, credentials true), and named outFields work. No license text was found. Do not use the statewide Minnesota parcel layers for owner search: the DNR plan_parcels_minnesota layer has owner_name but no county, parcel id or address field, so a query bleeds into neighbouring counties, and the MnGeo plan_parcels_open layer filters by co_code 27095 (20,928 rows) but its owner_name is blank for all but 550 rows (control: Itasca 27061, 0 populated). The same county server also lists Assessors/TaxParcels/MapServer/0, which has only a parcel name and geometry. Verified live 2026-10-03: taxpayer SMITH returned rows (first SMITH/BRIAN & ASHLEY, parcel 11-010-0100, 17903 130TH AVE, Milaca Township).
